item.subject: science
item.stem:
Myra labels four stomach agents on a science-fair poster: wall movements, digestive juice, acid, and mucus. She must match each to its job: churning food, breaking proteins into simpler components, killing many harmful bacteria, or protecting the stomach lining from acid.

Which matching is correct?

options.A: Wall movements — churning; mucus — protein breakdown; acid — killing bacteria; digestive juice — protecting the lining.
options.B: Wall movements — churning; digestive juice — protein breakdown; acid — killing bacteria; mucus — protecting the lining.
options.C: Wall movements — churning; digestive juice — protein breakdown; acid — killing bacteria; acid also damages the lining during ordinary digestion.
options.D: Wall movements — churning; digestive juice — protein breakdown in the oesophagus; acid — killing bacteria; mucus — protecting the lining.
